pool.rule: Every track draws ONLY from tips that (a) the CLEAN retrained models produce - prediction_engine_version resolves to an artifact sha256 listed in a stage of the owner's override clean-data-switch-2026-11-09 (config/promotion_overrides.json: first_refit, second_refit, final_refit; from 2026-11-21 the Nov 19-20 final refit) - and (b) clear the OWNER-APPROVED bars of that league x market: a bars_opt cell IDENTICAL to the cell of TP-2026-11-10-d999073a (hash-verified; or a later owner-approved R7 re-check proposal added to config/top3_paper_tracks.json -> approved_proposals), applied from that proposal (config/threshold_applied.json). No global bar, no legacy bar, no pre-repair or v9_repaired model, no unapproved cell. OFF cells give no candidates.
pool.same_as_production: candidates first seen strictly before FREEZE = the league-week's first kickoff - TOP3_FREEZE_LEAD_MIN (owner: 120 min), two-sided price, at or above the league's own bar; cap 3 per league per gameweek; fewer when fewer qualify (never padded); direction rule against the track's own picks of the week AND the fixture's live production tip; a candidate kicked off before issue is skipped

rules_common.per_league: Every statistic is per cell = (track, league, market-side), from that cell's own data, shrunk at most toward the SAME league's other markets. No cross-league pooling, no global constant.
rules_common.missing_statistic: A cell without the rule's statistic has none (nothing filled in): its tips rank after every tip that has one, among themselves by ev_est (the cell source's p_used * odds - 1), flagged no_stat.
rules_common.ties: ev_est, then kickoff, then fixture id

tracks.rule: the cell's own walk-forward bet ROI lower 95% bound (mean - Z95 * max-of-three SE) over >= MIN_OWN_BETS own bets

(fair + lam * (p_used - fair)) * odds - 1; lam = least squares slope of (won - fair) on (p_used - fair) over the cell's own priced rows (>= MIN_OWN_BETS), shrunk toward the same league's other markets (DerSimonian-Laird), clipped to [0, 1]

tracks.ledger: output/top3_league_ledger.csv (the production TOP-3, ranked by R3)
tracks.rule: as T2 with lam_lo = clip(lam - Z95 * se_own(lam), 0, 1)

live_statistics.frozen_at: 2026-11-20T23:59:59Z (scripts/top3_paper_freeze.py), after the R7 re-check / final refit and before the first 2026-11-21 kickoff; never updated during the test. ONE frozen record serves T1, T2 and T3.
live_statistics.predictions: the walk-forward predictions of the CLEAN retrained recipe: frame 58f10476f4c82d7b (standard run_20261110T203611Z, new_format run_20261110T203319Z), or the final-refit frame if it lands before the freeze - then the own-price universes are rebuilt on it, listed in config/top3_paper_tracks.json -> clean_frames, and the statistics are computed on the final frame BEFORE the freeze. Never from v9_repaired or pre-repair models. The frame hash is written into the record.
live_statistics.calibration_rows_T2_T3: every priced row of the cell in the own-price universe of that frame, dated before 2026-11-21, inside the cell's odds range, scored by the cell's SERVED source (src.bars_opt.serve.score with the approved cell). No OddsAPI history price is read.
live_statistics.bets_T1: the cell's served tips on those rows dated 2026-09-01..2026-11-20; a FRESH_HOLDOUT_SELECTION cell only if its family's fresh holdout ended before 2026-09-01, else no T1 statistic.
live_statistics.record: output/research/top3_ranking/live_stats_2026-11-20.json (statistics only) + output/research/top3_ranking/live_stats_ledger.json (its sha256), committed BEFORE the first pick. Not frozen in time -> no track starts (no fallback).

paper_tracking.start: league-weeks whose FREEZE is on or after 2026-11-21T00:00:00Z
paper_tracking.unit: 1 flat unit per pick at the price recorded at first sight; T1/T2 paper only, labelled PAPER/RESEARCH, never staked, executed or published
paper_tracking.settlement: the production TOP-3 settlement (src.top3_league.settle_picks rules: graded from the results feed after the settle delay; production void rules)
paper_tracking.ledger: one row per (track, league-week, rank), written once at FREEZE, frozen columns hash-checked on settlement

evaluation.tested_once: Each track is tested exactly once: at look 1 if it has >= 150 settled picks then, else at look 2. Below 150 at look 2 -> INCONCLUSIVE (its p counts as 1 in Holm). No other looks.
evaluation.statistic: ROI over the track's settled picks; one-sided p = src.league_bars.one_sided_p (bootstrap over match dates, N_BOOT, seed 0); 95% CI = src.bars_opt.study.score
evaluation.family: Holm (src.league_bars.holm) over the 3 tracks T1, T2, T3; at look 1 tracks not yet tested count as p = 1; at look 2 the final Holm uses every track's single test.
evaluation.pass: n >= 150 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.025 one-sided AND 95% CI lower bound > 0
evaluation.secondary_descriptive: paired league-week differences between tracks, CLV when graded, realised minus p_used, mix, no_stat picks. Never a pass criterion.
evaluation.consequence: The owner decides. Nothing switches automatically.
